CHAPTER 8 · ITEM 01 / 13

Tax revenue and deadweight loss

Reading a tax diagram讀稅收圖

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

On a supply-and-demand graph, identify the pretax equilibrium, the tax wedge, the prices paid and received, and the quantity traded after the tax.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

先找稅前交點 P0、Q0。稅後在同一個較低交易量 Qt，從需求讀 Pb、供給讀 Ps；垂直差額就是單位稅。

Locate the original intersection at P0,Q0. After tax, read buyer price from demand and seller price from supply at the same lower quantity Qt. Their vertical difference is the unit tax.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：P0=100,Q0=200; after tax Pb=120,Ps=90,Qt=180. The wedge is 30 and quantity falls 20.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Tax diagram gives Pb=14,Ps=10 at Qt=50. Unit tax? 單位稅？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
